entry.title: Sin Compromiso Paladin de Saka
entry.summaryHtml: Espresso, dark chocolate, earth, cedar, natural tobacco and pepper lead a dense but controlled profile, with the extra Pennsylvania seedleaf adding robustness without turning the cigar harsh. The firm box press and extended aging keep the smoke unusually polished for a blend with this much dark tobacco character.
entry.noteHtml: Paladin de Saka is the more robust, one-year-aged offshoot of Sin Compromiso and is made only in this 7″ × 52 firm-pressed format. Cigar Coop scored it 92 and singled out flavour as its strongest attribute, with medium strength and body rather than brute-force power.
productionLines: Handmade in Nicaragua at Fábrica de Tabacos Joya de Nicaragua
Wrapper: Mexican San Andrés Negro “Cultivo Tonto”
Filler: Independent-plantation Nicaraguan tobaccos and Pennsylvania seedleaf

note: Add Dunbarton Tobacco & Trust Sin Compromiso Paladin de Saka to the Panatelas, Coronas & Robustos subsection. Use the current Cigarbox single at A$69.80 as the Australian benchmark. This is the sole 7 x 52 firm-pressed Paladin vitola, made at Joya de Nicaragua with San Andrés Negro wrapper, Ecuador Habano thin-ligero binder, Nicaraguan filler and Pennsylvania seedleaf.
